intro.title: Created by nature, crafted by hand
paragraphs: Joe and Breda set up McNally Joinery in an old hay barn in 1978. Over the last 40 years the workshops have grown, and so has the range: spectacular staircases, welcoming front doors, floating pivot doors, traditional sliding sash and bay windows.

We take pride in our craftsmanship and offer you a complete joinery package. All our products are drawn to client specification and manufactured at our factory in North Dublin, giving you complete control over design, dimensions and lead times.
Working with architects, builders and home owners, we bring your ideas for quality joinery to life.

services.title: A complete joinery package

items.title: Full houses of joinery
items.text: Front doors, staircases, internal doors, windows, architraves and skirting for a whole home, made as one coherent package.

items.title: Staircases
items.text: Traditional, contemporary, curved, spiral or concrete clad: every staircase is tailored to the client's requirements, from the wood and finish to the spindles and handrails.

items.title: Sliding sash windows
items.text: Traditional sliding sash and bay windows. Our A and B energy rated windows are certified by the BFRC.

items.title: Pivot, sliding and bifold doors
items.text: Pivot, patio, bi-fold and sliding doors, each one tailored to your specific needs and preferences.

items.title: Front doors and gates
items.text: Colourful, welcoming front doors, external doors and gates.

items.title: Panelling, architraves and skirting
items.text: The finishing touches for a home or office. We can match existing architrave and skirting profiles for continuity throughout a project.
